profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Meta | Growth, Product & AI
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer at Meta working on user engagement and growth at Instagram. I’ve worked on Instagram’s first CTV product, helping launch the app to 1M+ downloads across Fire TV and Google TV and building a homepage experience that accounts for a large share of usage within the app.

My work sits at the intersection of product and engineering. I tend to take ideas from concept through launch, then improve them through iteration, performance work, and experimentation. I’ve spent time across growth, onboarding, and infrastructure.

I’ve also been exploring how AI can speed up product development, using it in workflows for UI implementation and validation. I’m especially interested in problems around growth, product, and AI-driven user experiences.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Instagram Experince Engineering Leadership
positions.description:
- Built a homepage experience for Instagram’s CTV app that now accounts for 75% of app usage, delivering in one month (vs. a projected half) by creating custom UI validation tooling and speeding up development workflows.
- Core contributor to Instagram for TV, Instagram’s first dedicated CTV product, launching to 1M+ downloads across Fire TV and Google TV on a shared React Native codebase.
- Cut Instagram for TV search page latency by 50% while improving recommendation quality, growing the surface to 30% of daily user visits and 3% of total time per DAU.
- Diagnosed and fixed a major performance issue in CTV search, reducing latency by 40% in one week by implementing client-side GraphQL streaming.
- Led a cross-team migration of Instagram’s web UI to achieve mobile parity and meet European Accessibility Act requirements, coordinating 5 engineers and delivering all P0 goals 3 months ahead of schedule.
- Identified a high-abandonment acquisition bottleneck in Instagram for TV’s login flow and developed a logged-out experience that increased top-of-funnel login opportunity by 80% without regressing existing conversion rates.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Instagram Growth
positions.description:
- Drove 4K DAU growth in the domestic young adult segment (4x above target) by improving user registration, optimizing upsell surfaces, and redesigning the first-time user experience.
- Defined and drove product strategy for key growth areas, including Instagram’s logged-out experience, aligning cross-functional teams around a roadmap that doubled projected impact.
- Improved conversion across the user funnel—from authentication through onboarding and upsell—by refining content alignment, social context, and entry points.
- Worked across product, design, and data to identify high-leverage opportunities and ship changes quickly, focusing on measurable impact rather than incremental gains.

positions.title: Software Engineer - AI Security and Privacy
positions.description:
- Built and deployed an access control system to secure internal ML models across 100+ teams, protecting $3B in annual revenue.
- Worked across backend and frontend systems (Python, PHP, React) to enforce safe usage patterns and reduce risk in high-impact ML workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Built Instagram’s logout validation service in Python, recovering ~36K failed logouts per day.
- Extended account recovery to support right-to-left languages, contributing to a 1% MAU increase and reducing SMS costs by 10%.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Built a YouTube preference storage API serving 700+ clients and 22B data points, supporting 300K+ queries per second.
- Migrated C++ and Java libraries to adopt the new system, improving consistency and scalability across clients.

positions.title: Target Acquisition System Developer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a multi-disciplinary team of professionals to develop a spacecraft imaging emulator for the NASA Mars Rover. 
- Led development on an image read/write algorithm in Python to cut compression time by 30%, utilized Huffman Coding techniques for image data compression. 
- Recognized weak points in the project’s code and applied improvements to help the program process data twice as fast.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a framework to generate and execute complex credit card transactions with an international development team.
- Implemented a training set generator to find desired past transactions using big data principles, Apache Spark, Couchbase, Hive, and Elasticsearch.
- Accelerated the data processing speed by 50% through optimization of the project’s memory management.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Worked with an Agile development team to develop full-stack customer applications with over 35,000 daily users. 
- Improved the accuracy of a heavily used call logging system through refactoring and debugging the outdated Java code. 
- Identified the need for an internal metrics dashboard and created it using Vue.js JavaScript, and RESTful APIs. The final product was used daily by 5 teams.

honors.title: WayUp Top 100 Intern 2020
honors.description: Out of thousands of students, I was selected by WayUp to be one of the top 100 interns of 2020 based of my accomplishments at American Express and future career goals!

honors.title: New American University President's Merit Scholarship
honors.issuer: Issued by Arizona State University  · Aug 2018

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Lead the largest computer science organization at ASU with 11 industry sponsors
- Grew undergraduate participation by 30% by reworking technical presentations to make them more suitable for beginners and engaging
- Hosted a software development career fair for 400+ students and 8 industry sponsors
